products.name: Nexora Pulse X1
products.description: The Pulse X1 pairs a 40mm titanium-coated driver with adaptive noise cancellation that samples your surroundings 600 times a second. Memory-foam earcups and a 248g frame keep it comfortable through long flights, and a 10-minute charge returns six hours of listening.
highlights: 40 hours playback, 6 hours from a 10-min charge

products.name: Nexora Pulse Air 2
products.tagline: True wireless earbuds with hybrid ANC
products.description: Pulse Air 2 fits six hours of playback into a 4.1g bud. Hybrid ANC cuts cabin and traffic noise, while four beam-forming mics keep calls clear in the wind. The case adds three full charges and supports wireless charging.

products.name: Nexora Sonar 3 Speaker
products.description: Two 15W drivers and a pair of passive radiators give the Sonar 3 a low end that belies its size. It survives a drop in the pool at IP67, runs 18 hours on a charge, and pairs with a second unit for stereo.
highlights: Stereo pairing with a second Sonar

products.name: Nexora Studio Monitor One
products.description: A flat, uncoloured response tuned for mixing decisions rather than excitement. The open-back grille gives a wide stage, the 250-ohm drivers scale with a proper amp, and the velour pads are user-replaceable.

products.name: Nexora Chrono 2
products.description: A 1.43" AMOLED panel at 466x466 under sapphire-hardened glass, wrapped in a 316L steel case. Dual-band GPS holds a lock under tree cover, and continuous SpO2 and heart-rate tracking still leave you two weeks between charges.

products.name: Nexora Chrono Lite
products.tagline: Everyday fitness watch with sleep staging
products.description: The Chrono Lite covers the essentials well: 120 workout modes, sleep staging with a morning readiness score, and a 1.32" display bright enough to read outdoors. At 32g it disappears overnight.

products.name: Nexora Halo Ring
products.description: Recovery tracking without a screen on your wrist. The Halo reads heart rate variability, skin temperature and movement through the night, then reports one number in the morning. Titanium shell, seven-day battery, no subscription.
highlights: HRV, skin temperature and sleep staging

products.name: Nexora Forge 75
products.description: A gasket-mounted 75% board with a CNC aluminium case, five layers of dampening and a sound profile closer to a custom build than an off-the-shelf keyboard. Hot-swap sockets take 3- and 5-pin switches; QMK/VIA remapping works out of the box.

products.name: Nexora Forge 65 Wireless
products.description: The 65% layout keeps arrow keys without the numpad, freeing desk space for the mouse. PBT double-shot caps, pre-lubed linears and a 3000mAh battery that lasts a month with the backlight off.
highlights: Up to 30 days on a charge

products.name: Nexora Dye-Sub Keycap Set
products.description: Cherry-profile PBT caps in a muted graphite and cream palette, dye-sublimated so the legends outlast the board. 142 keys cover 60% through full-size layouts including ISO and split-spacebar kits.

products.name: Nexora Vantage 5 Mouse
products.description: A 58g symmetrical shell over a 26,000 DPI optical sensor with a 1ms wireless polling rate. Optical switches rated to 90 million clicks remove the double-click failure that kills most mice, and 90 hours of battery means you charge it monthly.

products.name: Nexora Arena Headset
products.description: A 2.4GHz link at under 20ms latency, spatial audio tuned for footstep cues, and a detachable boom mic with a hardware mute. The suspension headband spreads weight so it stays comfortable across a long session.
highlights: Spatial audio with footstep EQ preset

products.name: Nexora Arena Controller
products.description: Hall-effect sticks that do not drift, four remappable back paddles and trigger stops for shooters. Profiles are stored on the controller, so your layout follows you between a PC and a handheld.

products.name: Nexora Glide XL Deskmat
products.description: A 900x400mm cloth surface over 4mm of natural rubber, with stitched edges that do not fray. The weave is tuned for a consistent glide on optical sensors and it rolls flat within an hour of unboxing.

products.name: Nexora Link 9 Dock
products.description: Nine ports from a single USB-C cable: two 4K60 displays, gigabit ethernet, an SD reader and 100W pass-through charging. The aluminium shell doubles as a heatsink so it stays cool under sustained transfer.

products.name: Nexora Riser Aluminium Stand
products.description: Milled from a single aluminium billet with silicone pads that grip without marking. Six height positions lift the screen to eye level, and the open frame keeps the laptop intake clear.

products.name: Nexora Vault 1TB SSD
products.description: A pocket NVMe drive that sustains 1050MB/s reads without thermal throttling, wrapped in a shock-resistant shell rated for a two-metre drop. Hardware AES-256 encryption is handled on the drive.

products.name: Nexora Slim Hub 7
products.description: The hub that lives in a laptop sleeve. Seven ports including 4K30 HDMI and 85W pass-through in a 62g aluminium body with a captive braided cable that cannot get lost.

products.name: Nexora Volt 20K Power Bank
products.description: Enough capacity for three phone charges or one laptop top-up, at 65W through USB-C PD. A small LCD shows exact remaining percentage instead of four ambiguous dots.

products.name: Nexora Volt GaN 65W Charger
products.description: GaN internals shrink a 65W three-port charger to roughly the footprint of a matchbox. Intelligent distribution gives the laptop what it needs and splits the rest between the phone and earbuds.
highlights: Charges laptop, phone and buds together

products.name: Nexora MagSnap Stand
products.description: A weighted magnetic stand that holds a phone at any angle for calls or a kitchen recipe, charging at 15W while it does. The aluminium base stays put when you pull the phone off one-handed.

products.name: Nexora Braided USB-C Cable 2m
products.description: Rated for 240W charging and 40Gbps transfer, with an aramid-reinforced core tested to 30,000 bends. It drives an 8K display and charges a laptop over the same two metres.

products.name: Nexora Gimbal Grip
products.description: Three-axis stabilisation that folds into a jacket pocket. Subject tracking holds a face through a crowd, and the built-in extension rod plus tripod foot covers vlogging without extra kit.

products.name: Nexora Sonar Mini
products.description: Clips to a backpack and runs 12 hours. Twelve watts is enough for a campsite or a balcony, and IPX7 means rain is not a reason to pack it away.
